verdict.rationale: The docs describe CrewAI's core as an open-source framework, with AMP as a managed layer on top. It installs locally via `uv tool install crewai`, its source is on GitHub, and the CLI can create, run, train and manage crews and flows on your own machine. A hands-on community report of running crews with local Ollama models corroborates local operation. missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement, documented self-hosted production deployment guidance, and a self-hostable equivalent of AMP features (Crew Studio, visual builders, managed deployment) that appear to be managed-only.
